links.outcome: Accuracy of customized deployed LLM configurations on TED multiple-choice questions versus base models
links.effect: GPT-4 76.2% and Claude 3.5 83.2%; customized TED-GPT 86.1% and TED-Claude 89.1%, outperforming newer LLMs.
links.quote: The addition of CoT, along with customization into GPT-4 and Claude 3.5, led to improvement in the accuracy (CoT-GPT 86.1%, CoT-Claude 87.1%, TED-GPT 86.1%, TED-Claude 89.1%), outperforming all other newer LLMs.

unlisted_practices: Domain-specific customization of LLMs (custom GPT/Claude configuration) to improve accuracy

screen.practice: domain-specific customization and Chain-of-Thought prompting of existing LLMs
screen.reason: The study empirically tests prompting strategies (Chain-of-Thought) and domain-specific customization guardrails/instructions on commercial LLMs to enhance performance, safety, and readability on thyroid eye disease queries.
